day2_after_start.text:
*The last class ends and Eunsu approaches.*

Ma'am, do I have to enter my student ID number in the app I downloaded from yesterday's leaflet? I thought I only needed my student card.

day2_after_eunsu_1.text: Wi-Fi, the library, even the cafeteria QR code all go through the app.

day2_after_eunsu_2.text: It's the final step of your official transfer registration. You need the Smart Campus module installed too for your QR code to scan from tomorrow.

day2_after_eunsu_3.text:
*The store lists 'Hanul Smart Campus', rated 4.8.*

So it links up with the safety app I provisionally installed yesterday. This is the one, right?

day2_after_eunsu_4.text:
*I tap Update and open the student ID number field.*

Where do I find my student number?

day2_after_eunsu_5.text: Here's your student number. The same number was on your desk, too.

day2_after_eunsu_6.text:
*The Post-it from my teacher already has a small check below the six-digit number. I enter it in the app.*

I'm in. What do I tap now?

day2_after_eunsu_7.text:
*When I entered my student number, permission requests appeared one after another.

[Location] Campus emergency location check
[Camera] Student ID QR
[Microphone] Emergency call*

I understand the camera for my ID. Can't the microphone switch on only during calls? Does it need my location all the time too?

day2_after_eunsu_8.text:
*A gray scrollbar remains below the permission window.*

There's more down there. Do I need all of them on?

choices: Change location to 'Only while using the app'

day2_after_allow_1.text: *I allow everything. I don't have the energy to go through the settings one by one.*

day2_after_limit_1.text: *App notification: 'Location permission is restricted. Emergency safety features will be disabled.'*

day2_after_limit_2.text: Set location to 'Always Allow.' It causes fewer problems on campus.

day2_after_limit_4.text: It changed after last year. The notification wording was added then too.

day2_after_limit_5.text: *The gray toggle on the settings screen turned blue. The app's `Safety Status` indicator at the bottom immediately turned green.*

day2_after_sea_1.text: You're here. The forms are over here.

day2_after_sea_2.text: I said I'd come. I waited by the door before coming in. That's okay, right?

day2_after_sea_4.text:
*Sea smiles. The hand she had been clenching under the desk loosens a little.*

Unclench your hand. Worried I'll mix up the papers?

day2_after_sea_5.text:
*Sports day paperwork covers the desk.*

All for sports day? That's quite a pile.

day2_after_sea_6.text: Sports day is next week. I need to organize the event programs and class applications.

day2_after_sea_7.text: I'll help. Give me the simple stuff first.

day2_after_sea_8.text: Is that so? Could you sort the applications by date?

day2_after_sea_9.text:
*Sea organized the event programs, and I sorted the application forms. The sound of turning pages continued steadily between us.*

By date, right? I'll keep the same day's together.

day2_after_sea_10.text: Look, Class 2 signed up for both tug-of-war and relay. Ambitious.

day2_after_sea_12.text: Our class... still hasn't turned theirs in. I need to collect them by tomorrow morning.

day2_after_sea_13.text: You can collect the rest from the other classes tomorrow. Don't rush to do it all yourself.

day2_after_sea_14.text: I was supposed to collect at least half by the end of today.

day2_after_sea_15.text:
*Sea sets the application form on the desk.*

*After we have worked for a while, she puts on some music. It's the band from lunch.*

That's the song you played at lunch.

day2_after_sea_16.text: When it's quiet, all you can hear is the paper.

day2_after_sea_17.text: *The sound of papers and music. Sunset light pours in through the window. Dust drifts slowly above the desk.*

day2_after_sea_18.text: {name}. Can I leave another chair out for you?

day2_after_sea_19.text: Wasn't there a spare chair here?

day2_after_sea_20.text:
*Sea looks out the window. Sunset falls across half her face. A single cup ring remains at the edge of the desk.*

There's only one cup mark. Do the other council members ever sit here?

day2_after_sea_21.text: There was, but no one ever sat there for long.

day2_after_sea_22.text:
*Sea tries to smile, but crumples the corner of the paper.*

The paper's crumpled. It's okay, you can smooth it out.

choices: "Wouldn't it go faster if we called the others?"
Pull out the chair without saying anything

day2_after_sea_23.text: Then, should we work here again tomorrow?

day2_after_sea_24.text: Yeah. I'll put your name on it so the applications don't get mixed up.

day2_after_sea_26.text:
*Sea starts writing my name on the label, then rewrites the letters a little smaller.*

Why write it smaller? It'll get lost between the forms.

day2_after_sea_28.text:
I can hear the paper now. This should do.

*After that, we worked without a word. The music was one notch lower than before.*

day2_after_sea_invite_1.text: Wouldn't it go faster if the other student council members helped too?

day2_after_sea_invite_2.text:
*Sea looks back and forth between the two empty chairs without answering right away.*

I was hoping more people would do it with me. If you don't want to, just say so.

day2_after_sea_invite_3.text: It's fine if it's just the two of us today. I'll keep your application separate.

day2_after_sea_invite_4.text: *I don't ask again. I pull out the chair.*

day2_after_sea_silent_1.text: *Instead of answering, I pulled a chair from the wall. Its legs scraped quietly across the floor.*

day2_after_sea_silent_2.text: Thanks. You can put it here.

day2_after_hallway_1.text: *Leaving the student council room, I walk down the hallway and find some classmates gathered by the vending machine.*

day2_after_hallway_2.text: Oh, {name}! What are you doing here?

day2_after_hallway_3.text: I was helping Sea in the student council room.

day2_after_hallway_4.text: Helping Sea? Already? You've only been here two days.

day2_after_hallway_5.text: Once the class rep gives you a job, you end up helping again and again.

day2_after_hallway_7.text: Hey, want something from the vending machine? I'll buy you one.

day2_after_hallway_8.text: Oh, no thanks. We've only just said hello. I'd feel bad letting you buy me a drink.

day2_after_hallway_9.text: Come on, it's your first week. Take it.

day2_after_hallway_10.text:
Thanks. Where's good to eat nearby? Tell me about sports day too.

*I took the can of coffee milk. It was cold.*

*We chatted for a while—places to eat near school, class names for sports day, how fast our homeroom teacher graded. Things like that.*

day2_after_hallway_11.text: *I rolled the can in my hand. Cold coffee milk. The same flavor as the one I got yesterday.*

day2_after_seolhwa_1.text:
*As I am about to leave through the school gate, a prickling sensation runs across my back.*

*I stop and turn around.*

day2_after_seolhwa_2.text: *It's Seolhwa. Standing inside the gate, watching me. In the sunset light. Her long hair drifts in the wind over her uniform.*

day2_after_seolhwa_3.text: *I blink once. She's still there, watching me, sunset caught around her eyes.*

day2_after_seolhwa_4.text: *Her lips move. I can't hear a sound. Even though the wind is blowing toward me.*

day2_after_seolhwa_5.text:
*My throat goes dry. I take one step toward Seolhwa.*

What? I can't hear you from here. I'll come closer.

day2_after_seolhwa_6.text: *A group of students passes between us, blocking my view for a moment. When I look again, Seolhwa is already walking away.*

day2_after_seolhwa_7.text: *Her retreating figure disappears across the schoolyard. She slips between the other students, but no one greets her.*

day2_after_seolhwa_8.text:
*Between the students' shoulders, I pictured where Seolhwa's empty desk had been.*

*Tomorrow, I'll look back before the bell rings.*

day2_after_sea_paper_1.text: *Sea held a finger against the paper’s corner. Once I lined up the stack, she clipped it. Our hands touched briefly.*

day2_after_sea_paper_2.text: How did you do this without me?

day2_after_sea_paper_3.text: Held the clip in my teeth. This is better. I can talk while I work.

day2_after_sea_paper_4.text: *Sea placed the next clip in my palm. I pulled my chair closer. This time, no papers slipped between us.*

day2_after_eunsu_checkin_1.text: Did you catch the right bus yesterday? I meant to ask before getting into paperwork.

day2_after_eunsu_checkin_2.text: Yes. I know my way home now.

day2_after_eunsu_checkin_3.text: Good. Let’s install the app together. Ask me about any field you don’t understand.

day2_after_detour_choice.text: *Outside the student council room, the sunset-lit hallway split in three directions.*
choices: Go straight to the central hallway vending machine
Stop at the library noticeboard on the way to the old building
Check the hallway window outside the first-floor infirmary

day2_after_detour_hall_1.text: *Wax marks on the central hallway floor gleamed in long streaks of evening light.*

day2_after_detour_hall_2.text: *As I let go of the door handle, I heard Sea quietly putting the chairs in order inside.*

day2_after_detour_hall_3.text: *My phone vibrated once in my pocket.*

day2_after_detour_hall_4.text: *When I took it out, a banner appeared at the top of the newly installed `Hanul Smart Campus` app: `Student council room stay confirmed`. Then it vanished.*

day2_after_detour_hall_5.text: I never scanned a QR code on the way in. How does it even know which room?

day2_after_detour_hall_6.text: *My battery had dropped by four percent since I last checked.*

day2_after_detour_hall_7.text: *I opened the app manager and tapped Force Stop, but the button was grayed out and did nothing.*

day2_after_detour_hall_8.text: *Around the corner, I heard classmates talking beneath the vending-machine light.*

day2_after_detour_hall_9.text: *I switched off the screen and put the phone away.*

day2_after_detour_hall_10.text: *Warm air hummed from the vent above the vending machine.*

day2_after_detour_hall_11.text: *One of them spotted me and waved.*

day2_after_detour_hall_12.text: *I relaxed my expression and walked toward the machine.*

day2_after_detour_lib_1.text: *A list of this month's recommended books and a photography-club exhibition notice were pinned to the board outside the library.*

day2_after_detour_lib_2.text: *Three black-and-white school photographs, apparently Yuna's, hung in a row beneath the exhibition notice.*

day2_after_detour_lib_3.text: *A blurry human silhouette stood at a third-floor window in the middle photograph.*

day2_after_detour_lib_4.text: That's the window I saw on my way home yesterday.

day2_after_detour_lib_5.text: *The library door behind me opened halfway, and Yuna peered out.*

day2_after_detour_lib_7.text: No, I just finished helping Sea sort paperwork. You took this photo on the board, right?

day2_after_detour_lib_8.text: *Yuna looked at the middle photograph, pulled out its pin, and took it down.*

day2_after_detour_lib_9.text: I put that one up by mistake last week. It got stained during printing, so I need to make another print.

day2_after_detour_lib_10.text: For a stain, it looks a lot like someone standing inside the window.

day2_after_detour_lib_11.text: It's a branch reflected in the glass. All the third-floor classrooms are empty after school.

day2_after_detour_lib_12.text: *Yuna slipped the photograph inside a folder and pressed it flat with both hands.*

day2_after_detour_lib_13.text: Please keep lunchtime free tomorrow. I have something to show you.

day2_after_detour_lib_14.text: *Yuna went inside and closed the library door. I headed for the central hallway vending machine.*

day2_after_detour_nur_1.text: *As I passed the first-floor infirmary, fluorescent light glowed through its frosted window.*

day2_after_detour_nur_2.text: *A low voice on the phone and the smell of disinfectant alcohol drifted through the door gap.*

day2_after_detour_nur_3.text: Yes, the first check is at lunch tomorrow. If they report dizziness, I'll have it ready right away.

day2_after_detour_nur_4.text: *I quieted my footsteps and stood against the wall beside the door. In the glass, Ms. Riin was reflected locking a cabinet.*

day2_after_detour_nur_5.text: *A moment later, Ms. Riin came out with her coat draped over her arm.*

day2_after_detour_nur_6.text: Oh, {name}? You haven't gone home yet?

day2_after_detour_nur_7.text: I was just coming down from the student council room. Who were you talking to?

day2_after_detour_nur_8.text: The medicine wholesaler. More students are complaining of anemia and dizziness this spring, so I ordered extra supplements.

day2_after_detour_nur_9.text: *Her explanation came smoothly, but the phone in her hand showed only a memo app.*

day2_after_detour_nur_10.text: If your head feels heavy tomorrow afternoon, come see me. I'll have everything ready.

day2_after_detour_nur_11.text: Okay. I'll keep that in mind.

day2_after_detour_nur_12.text: *Ms. Riin gave my shoulder a light tap as she walked ahead toward the entrance.*

day2_after_detour_nur_13.text: *Her coat carried a cold smell of alcohol instead of chamomile.*

day2_after_detour_nur_14.text: *I turned back toward the hallway with the vending machine.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trace_choice.text: *Only long sunset shadows remained on the path inside the gate where Seolhwa had disappeared.*
choices: Examine the paving stones where Seolhwa stood
Look up at the third-floor window of the main building Seolhwa entered

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_1.text: *I walked to the paving stones beneath the ginkgo tree where Seolhwa had stood and looked down.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_2.text: *A half-broken piece of white chalk lay in a crack between the dry paving stones.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_3.text: *I picked it up, and white dust coated my fingertips. It was the same chalk kept beside the classroom blackboard.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_4.text: The way her lips moved just now. I could swear she was saying my name.

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_5.text: *The last sound was longer than two open syllables. Maybe she'd said, 'Don't go.'*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_6.text: *I raised my head toward the far-left window on the main building’s third floor.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_7.text: *Someone had definitely been standing there at this time yesterday. Today the curtains were half drawn.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_8.text: *The wind pushed only the white curtain through the open window.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_9.text: *A green monitor flickered behind the window of the caretaker's booth at the gate.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_10.text: *My phone buzzed briefly again. The notification read `Departure checkpoint passed`.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_11.text: Does it log me every time I pass the front gate?

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_12.text: *I pushed the chalk deep into my pocket and walked down the slope outside the gate.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_13.text: *Streetlights came on one by one, stretching my shadow behind me.*

day2_after_seolhwa_trc_14.text: *Tomorrow morning, I should check the back desk before anyone else arrives.*
